statements.status_notes: erb 4.0.3.1 (the fix) is installed and active at runtime. The scanner reports the old 4.0.3 default gemspec at /usr/local/lib/ruby/gems/3.3.0/specifications/default/erb-4.0.3.gemspec which Ruby retains as a fallback. The patched version takes precedence: `gem list erb` shows '4.0.3.1, default: 4.0.3'.
